nodes.label: Neo Explorer read-only chain workbench
nodes.rationale: Deliberately has no wallet connection, no signing, no payment and no miniapp-owned contract; it is a pure query surface over the platform Explorer API.

nodes.label: Mainnet/testnet independent query channels
nodes.rationale: Switching networks clears prior results and reloads that network's recent transactions so a record from one network can never be attributed to the other.

nodes.label: Supported identifier resolution table
nodes.rationale: Block height, 0x+64 hex tx/block hash, 34-char Neo address and 0x+40 hex contract hash each map to a distinct resolution path; client validation mirrors the production Explorer API.

nodes.label: Indexer-first with Neo RPC fallback
nodes.rationale: Transaction detail, address activity, execution traces and contract invocations prefer the indexer and fall back to Neo RPC; the UI distinguishes found / valid-but-absent / invalid / service-unavailable instead of fabricating a result.

nodes.label: Late response discard on network or query change
nodes.rationale: After switching network or issuing a newer search, a slower in-flight response must not overwrite the current surface; a network switch during a recent-transactions load queues the new request rather than waiting for the next poll.

nodes.label: Explicit cache snapshot labeling
nodes.rationale: Cached data is always marked as a snapshot; a failed live request never relabels cache as live data.

nodes.label: Shared CoinArt token identity policy
nodes.rationale: Official NEO/GAS CoinArt plus Lucide semantic icons are shared; token logos are never redrawn per MiniApp, and no inline SVG, CSS/div artwork, emoji or placeholder asset is permitted.

nodes.label: Unresolved raster generation and license record
nodes.rationale: Git history proves repository custody but not original model/provider terms; the file records available evidence rather than inventing attribution, and flags resolution as a prerequisite to external distribution.

nodes.label: MiniAppFlashLoan v3.0.0 dual-network deployment
nodes.rationale: Mainnet 0xb5d8fb0dc2319edc4be3104304b4136b925df6e4 (magic 860833102) and testnet 0xde8e595d8d3c293731db499367ee2a768e1e458b (magic 894710606); the manifest defaults a missing launch-network hint to mainnet and binds both hashes explicitly.

nodes.label: deposit ABI (network-divergent arity)
nodes.rationale: Mainnet takes deposit(depositor, amount, receiptId) while testnet takes deposit(depositor, amount); the frontend keeps the two lanes separate rather than normalizing to one signature.

nodes.label: Fixed8 integer-string money discipline
nodes.rationale: All monetary values stay decimal Fixed8 integer strings through wallet args, pending records, events and authoritative reads; decimal conversion is confined to the display edge so rounding can never enter a signed argument.

nodes.label: Testnet callback harness execute(borrower, amount, fee, loanId)
nodes.rationale: 0x7aa01290d33f6b2313a7efd6acde58f3e64b636f returned HALT under a non-persisting signer simulation while onFlashLoan returned FAULT; recorded as ABI-compatibility evidence only, not availability or a successful user loan.

nodes.label: Flash Loan DeFi execution desk surface
nodes.rationale: Principal, pool, fee, exact repayment, callback target, eligibility, network and contract health stay co-visible before signing; mobile preserves readable signing evidence rather than compressing it to 8-9 px labels.

nodes.label: Single synchronous financial write lock
nodes.rationale: Loan, deposit, finalize-only recovery and withdrawal share one lock so host action dispatch cannot open a second wallet flow; persisted pending records extend the block across flows after the call returns.

nodes.label: Event-plus-readback success gate
nodes.rationale: A broadcast payload, callback, timeout or txid alone is never success; the transaction-bound event, matching field values, matching readback and fresh platform/eligibility reads must all agree.

nodes.label: Network-, contract- and wallet-bound recovery
nodes.rationale: A recovered prior action is reported as prior history rather than replayed, and recovery storage must pass a write/read/delete round trip before the wallet opens.

nodes.label: Wallet-scoped refresh and lookup epochs
nodes.rationale: Slower reads issued for an old wallet or an older loan lookup cannot overwrite the newest product state.

nodes.label: Canonical Hash160 argument builder
nodes.rationale: Base58 wallet accounts and script hashes are normalized to one ABI-correct argument shape across adapters before every loan, deposit and withdrawal write.

nodes.label: FAULT versus unknown-state distinction
nodes.rationale: Unknown state, missing event, readback disagreement and stale indexer state stay pending or manual-review; only a proven VM FAULT clears the failed action.

nodes.label: Flash Loan MiniApp (miniapp-flashloan)
nodes.rationale: DeFi category, version 1.1.0, GAS asset, Neo-specific four-argument callback model; the first screen is an execution desk rather than a parameter form.

nodes.label: Atomic callback loan route
nodes.rationale: Lender transfers principal to the callback contract and invokes callbackMethod(borrower, amount, fee, loanId) in the same transaction; a missing, faulting or under-repaying callback FAULTs the whole transaction.

nodes.label: Deliberate divergence from ERC-3156
nodes.rationale: The deployed interface is Neo-native four-argument callback, not the Ethereum flash-loan standard; live constants are 1 GAS min, 100,000 GAS configured max, 9 bps fee, 300 s cooldown, 10 loans/day, 80% LP fee share.

nodes.label: Testnet prepaid deposit finalize-only recovery
nodes.rationale: Finalize-only unlocks only after the exact confirmed GAS transfer is observed, so a FAULTing consuming deposit leaves the prepayment recoverable without a second transfer.

nodes.label: 原子资金路线 (atomic callback route, zh)
User-photo custody boundary
nodes.rationale: Photos are chosen at runtime, stored only in that wallet's local browser partition, and never bundled, uploaded or claimed by the app.

nodes.label: Network-neutral no-chain execution model
nodes.rationale: MainNet and TestNet hosts both open it but selection changes nothing: no RPC read, contract call, payment, transaction, NFT mint, oracle request or remote-storage operation exists, so verification targets storage rather than chain execution.

nodes.label: forever-album:photos:<address> partition key
nodes.rationale: The connected address only names a local key inside this browser profile; it does not prove photo ownership and does not make the album reachable from another browser, device or network.

nodes.label: Real file-signature import validation
nodes.rationale: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and GIF imports are checked against real magic bytes instead of trusting the filename or the browser MIME claim.

nodes.label: Five-photo / 768 KiB / 2 MiB / 3 MiB capacity ladder
AES-256-GCM versioned ciphertext envelope
nodes.rationale: Random 16-byte salt, random 12-byte IV and PBKDF2-SHA-256 derivation; passwords require confirmation, are never persisted, and malformed envelopes are excluded during recovery.

nodes.label: Exact read-back verification before reporting success
nodes.rationale: Every local save, delete, reset and storage probe is confirmed by reading the value back, so a silently dropped write is never rendered as a saved album.

nodes.label: Wallet-switch state and in-flight decrypt invalidation
nodes.rationale: Decryption is bound to the active wallet, target photo and open unlock dialog so a slower AES-GCM result cannot reveal a photo from the previous partition; a first connection may retain an unowned draft so connect-on-save does not discard the selection.

nodes.label: Quota and corrupt-album failure recovery
nodes.rationale: Failed writes preserve the selected batch, existing albums stay readable so users can delete to free space, duplicate record IDs are treated as damaged rows, and unreadable albums offer a wallet-scoped reset.

nodes.label: Forever Album MiniApp
nodes.rationale: Social-category app at version 1.2.0 built on the shared React miniapp framework; the wallet is a local album identity only, never a signer or payer.

nodes.label: Device-local, wallet-partitioned storage model
nodes.rationale: No contract, chain read, platform-storage write, cloud sync or recovery service exists; clearing site data is unrecoverable, so the UI tells users to keep originals elsewhere rather than implying durability.

nodes.label: Versioned localStorage album envelope
nodes.rationale: The forever-album: framework namespace is retained for migration compatibility and the reader still accepts the earlier bare-array local format.

nodes.label: gas-sponsor-refill-station.webp scene
nodes.rationale: Used as an in-app environment behind a high-contrast foreground control card, not as a promotional cover pasted behind form controls.

nodes.label: CoinArt canonical GAS token artwork from apps/shared/art
MiniAppGasSponsor v2.0.0 dual-network deployment
nodes.rationale: MainNet 0x80ea8435a88334b9b80077220097d88c440615f1 and TestNet 0x31888679572bf2de61462ff9934b6265d60284f2, both unpaused; TestNet holds 36 pools with 0 active and 0 GAS contract balance.

nodes.label: Sponsorship pool lifecycle events
nodes.rationale: SponsorshipCreated, SponsorshipClaimed, PoolRefunded, PoolExtended and PoolDepleted are the confirmation anchors for the five write paths.

nodes.label: Honest empty live-station state
nodes.rationale: With the newest TestNet pool expired at zero remaining, the app renders an empty station rather than implying claimable liquidity, while keeping recent pools inspectable.

nodes.label: Pool-first visual hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Pool, remaining GAS and expiry are primary; exact parameters and sponsor lifecycle controls are demoted to secondary drawers.

nodes.label: Separately persisted payment and target phases
nodes.rationale: Prepaid create/top-up flows persist payment and target transaction IDs separately so recovery resumes the target call without sending GAS twice.

nodes.label: Event-plus-pool-readback confirmation gate
nodes.rationale: Every broadcast transaction stays pending until its required event/receipt and the authoritative pool readback agree.

nodes.label: Gas Sponsor MiniApp (miniapp-gas-sponsor)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately an on-chain community pool app replacing the retired platform faucet API; it is not a transfer to a hard-coded operator wallet.

nodes.label: Wallet-free public pool browsing
nodes.rationale: Live and historical pools are inspectable without connecting; a wallet is requested only at the claim or sponsor step.

nodes.label: Sponsorship pool lifecycle (create, claim, top up, extend, withdraw)
nodes.rationale: Pool type 1 is the public community path; minimums are 1 GAS to create, 0.1 GAS max claim per transaction and 0.5 GAS to top up.

nodes.label: Actual chain expiry over nominal defaultExpirySeconds
nodes.rationale: The contract reports defaultExpirySeconds = 2592000 but real pool timestamps differ by 2,592,000 milliseconds (~43.2 minutes), so the UI shows the observed expiry and refuses to call it 30 days.

nodes.label: GAS 社区赞助池 (Chinese product doc)
Resource-led civic auction desk surface
nodes.rationale: gov-merc-market-stage.webp dominates with one contextual primary action; balances, exits, reclaim, rules and diagnostics live in the detail drawer and motion is driven only by real in-flight business state.

nodes.label: Durable payment/action transaction journal
nodes.rationale: Storage preflight plus exact txid persistence scoped to the network/contract/wallet binding, written as soon as a payment or contract transaction ID is broadcast.

nodes.label: Read-only refresh recovery
nodes.rationale: Recovery after a page refresh never signs, pays or resubmits; it only inspects the journal and chain state.

nodes.label: Failed reads stay unavailable, never zero
nodes.rationale: A read failure must not be rendered as a zero balance, an empty market or an unopened bidding window, because those are actionable business states a user could trade on.

nodes.label: Gov Merc MiniApp (miniapp-gov-merc)
nodes.rationale: Governance category, version 1.1.0, host-native React playarea requiring payments and governance permissions with GAS as the only allowed asset.

nodes.label: MiniAppGovMerc v2 bound contract
nodes.rationale: 0x140f5faf5692d21421a79278b0e45b9b9bd4bb46 on both networks with minBid = 100000000 (1 GAS) and epochDuration = 300000 ms; the first bid opens a fixed 5-minute window and settlement unlocks after it.

nodes.label: MiniAppGovMerc v1 exit-only integration
nodes.rationale: 0x1eb83eb5d4d3f073112064e8a3825f3b0e5f88e9 stays live for withdraw-stake, reclaim-bid and withdraw-credit only; its legacy bid/settle methods are still exposed, so the restriction is platform policy in the app rather than a contract-level pause.

nodes.label: Staked NEO as reward-share weight
nodes.rationale: The contract holds stake purely as a pro-rata weight over auction revenue and explicitly does not delegate or cast a vote with it.

nodes.label: Per-epoch GAS influence-title auction
nodes.rationale: The on-chain record is the influence title only; any vote execution happens off-contract, and the winning bid is distributed pro-rata to stakers.

nodes.label: Permissionless epoch settlement
nodes.rationale: Anyone can settle a closed epoch, so payout to stakers does not depend on the winner or an operator acting.

nodes.label: Recovered bid credit consumed before new payment
nodes.rationale: When a bid payment lands but the bid action does not, only the shortfall is paid before the wallet calls bid, so a stranded prepayment is never abandoned or duplicated.

nodes.label: Whole-NEO and 8-decimal GAS input validation
nodes.rationale: Fractional NEO is rejected outright rather than silently truncated, because truncation would sign a different amount than the user typed.
